raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#39278 added `|<image>` to Qwen-VL's `image_token_regex`. Chat-template prompts already carry the image as `<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>`, so a literal `<image>` in the question text (common in MMMU, e.g. `"This Roman portrait mummy <image> ..."`) is counted as a **second** image slot for **one** image. `legacy_load_mm_data` then hits an unhandled `StopIteration` and the request fails with HTTP 500 (`An exception occurred while loading multimodal data`), which breaks every such MMMU request.

Repro (any Qwen-VL server): a chat request with one `image_url` and text `"What is shown in <image>?"` returns 500.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/qwen_vl.py`:

1. Revert `image_token_regex` to match only the native placeholder, as before #39278.
2. In `_normalize_prompt_for_fast_path`, rewrite `<image>` to the native placeholder only when the prompt has no `<|vision_start|>`. This keeps the raw `/generate` behavior #39278 added without breaking chat-template prompts.

```diff
             image_token_regex=re.compile(
-                r"<\|vision_start\|>(?:<\|image_pad\|>)+<\|vision_end\|>|<image>"
+                r"<\|vision_start\|>(?:<\|image_pad\|>)+<\|vision_end\|>"
             ),
@@ def _normalize_prompt_for_fast_path(self, input_text, expected_image_count: int)
         native = self.mm_tokens.image_token
+        # sglang's <image> sentinel marks an image only in raw prompts;
+        # next to native vision tokens it is literal text (e.g. MMMU questions).
+        if "<|vision_start|>" not in input_text:
+            input_text = input_text.replace("<image>", native)
         normalized, count = self.mm_tokens.image_token_regex.subn(native, input_text)
```

## Tests

New CPU unit test `test/registered/unit/multimodal/test_qwen_vl_image_sentinel.py` (registered in `base-a-test-cpu`), using a real `QwenVLImageProcessor`:

- Chat prompt with literal `<image>` plus one native placeholder and 1 image: resolves to 1 image with the prompt unchanged. On `main` this raises `RuntimeError`.
- Raw `<image>` prompt with 1 image: stays on the artifact fast path and is rewritten to the native placeholder, as in #39278. A plain revert of the regex fails this test.

Both pass locally. The existing `test_qwen3_vl_feature_materialization.py`, `test_media_artifact_processor.py` and `test_processor_async_call_sites.py` also pass. Hot-path cost is one substring check. No end-to-end MMMU run is attached yet.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (not needed)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

Reproduced on v0.5.21 (latest release, 2026-09-29) + transformers 5.12.1, Qwen3.8-VL, CUDA — in a real-world agentic scenario, which is a bit nastier than the single-request MMMU case:

Our multi-turn session history contained literal `<image>` in assistant text (script usage lines: `find-cursor.sh <image> <cropw> ...` and `find_cursor.py <image> [roi ...]`). The first request after those messages hit the unhandled `StopIteration` in `legacy_load_mm_data` and 500ed with `An exception occurred while loading multimodal data` — and **every subsequent turn failed too**, because the full history (including the literal tokens) is re-sent each turn. So a single model output containing `<image>` (common in code: usage strings, placeholder examples) permanently breaks a growing conversation.

Count mismatch exactly as described: 23 `image_url` parts + 3 literal `<image>` occurrences = 26 placeholder tokens vs 23 data items → `Mismatch: More 'IMAGE' tokens found than corresponding data provided` → `StopIteration`.

Worked around it by rewriting the literal strings in history (one-off, storage-level). The server-side fix in this PR is the durable fix — happy to help test it on a Qwen3-VL NVFP4 server.

Follow-up datapoint correction: in our repro the literal in the text was `<image_path>` (the legacy Qwen placeholder, as in script usage lines like `find_cursor.py <image_path> [roi ...]`), not `<image>`.

Verified against the v0.5.21 code:

1. `QwenVLImageProcessor.image_token` is the expanded native token (vision-start + one image-pad + vision-end, single pad), so the exact-match branch in `get_modality_of_token` never fires for a literal.
2. `image_token_regex` is `vision-start(?:image-pad)+vision-end | <image>` — and `re` cannot match the `<image>` alternative inside the string `<image_path>` (the closing bracket is absent there; the prefix is `<image_`). So the regex branch never fires either.

Nevertheless, literal `<image_path>` in chat history breaks Qwen3-VL requests on v0.5.21 + transformers 5.12.1: 23 `image_url` parts + 3 literal `<image_path>` occurrences in assistant text produced `Mismatch: More 'IMAGE' tokens found than corresponding data provided` followed by an unhandled `StopIteration` in `legacy_load_mm_data` (HTTP 500). Rewriting the literals to a non-token string fixed it — so the counting is real, it just does not go through the branches above.

Suspected source: the model's own tokenizer maps the legacy `<image_path>` surface form to the image-pad token id during chat-template rendering, inflating the placeholder count before sglang's string-level checks ever see it. The fix here covers the `<image>` sentinel; the `<image_path>` surface form looks like a sibling case worth handling in the same place. Happy to provide the full request/traceback pair on request.

@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+"""Qwen-VL image placeholder counting with the legacy ``<image>`` sentinel.
+
+A chat-templated prompt already carries one native vision placeholder per image,
+so a literal ``<image>`` in the question text (as in MMMU) is not an image slot.
+A raw ``/generate`` prompt without native tokens still uses ``<image>`` as one.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+import unittest
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+from PIL import Image
+
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.base_processor import BaseMultimodalProcessor
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.qwen_vl import (
+    QwenVLImagePreprocessArtifact,
+    QwenVLImageProcessor,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=11, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+NATIVE_IMAGE = "<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>"
+CHAT_PROMPT = (
+    "<|im_start|>user\nThis Roman portrait mummy <image> is from the 1st century AD."
+    f"{NATIVE_IMAGE}Which technique was used?<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
+)
+RAW_PROMPT = "<image>\nDescribe the image."
+
+
+class _Reached(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def _base_init(self, hf_config, *args, **kwargs):
+    self.hf_config = hf_config
+
+
+def _make_processor(model_type):
+    hf_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_type=model_type,
+        vision_start_token_id=1,
+        vision_end_token_id=2,
+        image_token_id=3,
+        video_token_id=4,
+        vision_config=SimpleNamespace(spatial_merge_size=2),
+    )
+    hf_processor = SimpleNamespace(
+        tokenizer=SimpleNamespace(convert_ids_to_tokens=lambda ids: ["<|video_pad|>"])
+    )
+    with patch.object(BaseMultimodalProcessor, "__init__", _base_init):
+        processor = QwenVLImageProcessor(hf_config, None, hf_processor)
+    processor.mm_preprocess_cache = SimpleNamespace(enabled=False)
+    processor.skip_tokenizer_init = False
+    processor.video_config = {}
+    return processor
+
+
+def _request():
+    return SimpleNamespace(video_data=None, audio_data=None, rid="rid")
+
+
+class TestQwenVLImageSentinel(CustomTestCase):
+    def _hf_processor_input(self, prompt):
+        """Run the uncached path up to the HF processor call; return its input."""
+        processor = _make_processor("qwen2_5_vl")
+        processor.io_executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
+        self.addCleanup(processor.io_executor.shutdown)
+        seen = {}
+
+        async def capture(base_output, mm_tokens, **kwargs):
+            seen["text"] = base_output.input_text
+            seen["num_images"] = len(base_output.images)
+            raise _Reached
+
+        processor.process_and_combine_mm_data_async = capture
+        image = Image.new("RGB", (32, 32))
+        with self.assertRaises(_Reached):
+            asyncio.run(processor.process_mm_data_async([image], prompt, _request()))
+        return seen
+
+    def _artifact_fast_path_input(self, prompt):
+        """Run the artifact fast path up to prompt expansion; return its input."""
+        processor = _make_processor("qwen3_vl")
+        artifact = QwenVLImagePreprocessArtifact(
+            content_digest="digest",
+            artifact_key="key",
+            feature_hash=0,
+            feature=None,
+            model_specific_data={"image_grid_thw": torch.tensor([[1, 4, 4]])},
+        )
+
+        async def prepare(image_data, content_hashes=None):
+            return [artifact]
+
+        async def uncached(*args, **kwargs):
+            raise AssertionError("fast path fell back to full preprocessing")
+
+        seen = {}
+
+        def build(input_text, grid_key):
+            seen["text"] = input_text
+            raise _Reached
+
+        processor.prepare_media_artifacts_without_cache = prepare
+        processor._process_mm_data_uncached = uncached
+        processor._build_image_prompt_template = build
+        with self.assertRaises(_Reached):
+            asyncio.run(processor.process_mm_data_async(["image"], prompt, _request()))
+        return seen["text"]
+
+    def test_literal_image_text_next_to_native_placeholder_is_one_image(self):
+        """A literal <image> beside a native placeholder must not count as a second
+        image: the uncached path used to fail with "An exception occurred while
+        loading multimodal data" and the fast path used to be skipped."""
+        seen = self._hf_processor_input(CHAT_PROMPT)
+        self.assertEqual(seen["num_images"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(seen["text"], CHAT_PROMPT)
+
+        self.assertEqual(self._artifact_fast_path_input(CHAT_PROMPT), CHAT_PROMPT)
+
+    def test_legacy_image_sentinel_stays_on_artifact_fast_path(self):
+        expected = RAW_PROMPT.replace("<image>", NATIVE_IMAGE)
+        self.assertEqual(self._artifact_fast_path_input(RAW_PROMPT), expected)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
